+#define COPY_SMALL(from, to, count) do {                                       \
+  assert((count) <= 8, "small copy only");                                     \
+  julong tmp0, tmp1, tmp2, tmp3, tmp4, tmp5, tmp6, tmp7;                       \
+  __asm__ volatile(                                                            \
+    "li %[t0], 4\n"                                                            \
+    "bgeu %[cnt], %[t0], 4f\n"                                                 \
+    "li %[t0], 2\n"                                                            \
+    "bgeu %[cnt], %[t0], 2f\n"                                                 \
+    "beqz %[cnt], 9f\n"                                                        \
+    "ld %[t0], 0(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t0], 0(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "j 9f\n"                                                                   \
+    "2:\n"                                                                     \
+    "bne %[cnt], %[t0], 3f\n"                                                  \
+    "ld %[t0], 0(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t1], 8(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t0], 0(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t1], 8(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "j 9f\n"                                                                   \
+    "3:\n"                                                                     \
+    "ld %[t0], 0(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t1], 8(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t2], 16(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t0], 0(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t1], 8(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t2], 16(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "j 9f\n"                                                                   \
+    "4:\n"                                                                     \
+    "li %[t0], 6\n"                                                            \
+    "bgeu %[cnt], %[t0], 6f\n"                                                 \
+    "li %[t0], 4\n"                                                            \
+    "bne %[cnt], %[t0], 5f\n"                                                  \
+    "ld %[t0], 0(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t1], 8(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t2], 16(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t3], 24(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t0], 0(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t1], 8(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t2], 16(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t3], 24(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "j 9f\n"                                                                   \
+    "5:\n"                                                                     \
+    "ld %[t0], 0(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t1], 8(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t2], 16(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t3], 24(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t4], 32(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t0], 0(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t1], 8(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t2], 16(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t3], 24(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t4], 32(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "j 9f\n"                                                                   \
+    "6:\n"                                                                     \
+    "li %[t0], 8\n"                                                            \
+    "beq %[cnt], %[t0], 8f\n"                                                  \
+    "li %[t0], 6\n"                                                            \
+    "bne %[cnt], %[t0], 7f\n"                                                  \
+    "ld %[t0], 0(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t1], 8(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t2], 16(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t3], 24(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t4], 32(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t5], 40(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t0], 0(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t1], 8(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t2], 16(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t3], 24(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t4], 32(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t5], 40(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "j 9f\n"                                                                   \
+    "7:\n"                                                                     \
+    "ld %[t0], 0(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t1], 8(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t2], 16(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t3], 24(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t4], 32(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t5], 40(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t6], 48(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t0], 0(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t1], 8(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t2], 16(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t3], 24(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t4], 32(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t5], 40(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t6], 48(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "j 9f\n"                                                                   \
+    "8:\n"                                                                     \
+    "ld %[t0], 0(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t1], 8(%[s])\n"                                                      \
+    "ld %[t2], 16(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t3], 24(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t4], 32(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t5], 40(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t6], 48(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "ld %[t7], 56(%[s])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t0], 0(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t1], 8(%[d])\n"                                                      \
+    "sd %[t2], 16(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t3], 24(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t4], 32(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t5], 40(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t6], 48(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "sd %[t7], 56(%[d])\n"                                                     \
+    "9:\n"                                                                     \
+    : [t0] "=&r" (tmp0), [t1] "=&r" (tmp1),                                    \
+      [t2] "=&r" (tmp2), [t3] "=&r" (tmp3),                                    \
+      [t4] "=&r" (tmp4), [t5] "=&r" (tmp5),                                    \
+      [t6] "=&r" (tmp6), [t7] "=&r" (tmp7)                                     \
+    : [s] "r" (from), [d] "r" (to), [cnt] "r" (count)                          \
+    : "memory");                                                               \
+} while (false)
+
+static void pd_prefetch_words(const HeapWord* from) {
+  // Encode prefetch.r as ORI for assemblers without Zicbop support.
+  // CPUs without Zicbop treat this HINT as a NOP.
+  __asm__ volatile("ori zero, %[s], 1" :: [s] "r" (from) : "memory");
+}
+
@@ -57,1 +176,6 @@
-  (void)memmove(to, from, count * HeapWordSize);
+  pd_prefetch_words(from);
+  if (__builtin_expect(count <= 8, 1)) {
+    COPY_SMALL(from, to, count);
+  } else {
+    _Copy_conjoint_words(from, to, count);
+  }
@@ -61,13 +185,9 @@
-  switch (count) {
-    case 8:  to[7] = from[7];   // fall through
-    case 7:  to[6] = from[6];   // fall through
-    case 6:  to[5] = from[5];   // fall through
-    case 5:  to[4] = from[4];   // fall through
-    case 4:  to[3] = from[3];   // fall through
-    case 3:  to[2] = from[2];   // fall through
-    case 2:  to[1] = from[1];   // fall through
-    case 1:  to[0] = from[0];   // fall through
-    case 0:  break;
-    default:
-      memcpy(to, from, count * HeapWordSize);
-      break;
+  if (__builtin_constant_p(count)) {
+    memcpy(to, from, count * HeapWordSize);
+    return;
+  }
+  pd_prefetch_words(from);
+  if (__builtin_expect(count <= 8, 1)) {
+    COPY_SMALL(from, to, count);
+  } else {
+    _Copy_disjoint_words(from, to, count);
@@ -78,1 +198,6 @@
-  shared_disjoint_words_atomic(from, to, count);
+  pd_prefetch_words(from);
+  if (__builtin_expect(count <= 8, 1)) {
+    COPY_SMALL(from, to, count);
+  } else {
+    _Copy_disjoint_words(from, to, count);
+  }

+#include "defs.S.inc"
+
+// Load a one-byte VM flag through the GOT. Clobbers dst.
+    .macro LOAD_BOOL_FLAG flag, dst
+    .option push
+    .option pic
+    la      \dst, \flag
+    .option pop
+    lbu     \dst, 0(\dst)
+    .endm
+
+// RVV requires both build-time support and UseRVV. Clobbers tmp.
+    .macro BRANCH_IF_RVV target, tmp
+#if defined(__riscv_vector) && __riscv_v_elen >= 64
+    LOAD_BOOL_FLAG UseRVV, \tmp
+    bnez    \tmp, \target
+#endif
+    .endm
+
+// a0: source, a1: destination, a2: count in eight-byte HeapWords.
+// The caller handles counts of eight words or fewer.
+// Both addresses must be HeapWord aligned for per-word atomicity.
+// Load each chunk before storing to preserve overlapping source data.
+
+    .text
+    .p2align 5
+DECLARE_FUNC(_Copy_disjoint_words):
+    BRANCH_IF_RVV .Lforward_rvv, t0
+    li      a4, 8
+    bltu    a2, a4, .Lforward_tail
+
+    .p2align 4
+.Lforward_loop:
+    ld      t0, 0(a0)
+    ld      t1, 8(a0)
+    ld      t2, 16(a0)
+    ld      t3, 24(a0)
+    ld      t4, 32(a0)
+    ld      t5, 40(a0)
+    ld      t6, 48(a0)
+    ld      a3, 56(a0)
+    sd      t0, 0(a1)
+    sd      t1, 8(a1)
+    sd      t2, 16(a1)
+    sd      t3, 24(a1)
+    sd      t4, 32(a1)
+    sd      t5, 40(a1)
+    sd      t6, 48(a1)
+    sd      a3, 56(a1)
+    addi    a0, a0, 64
+    addi    a1, a1, 64
+    addi    a2, a2, -8
+    bgeu    a2, a4, .Lforward_loop
+
+.Lforward_tail:
+    andi    t0, a2, 4
+    beqz    t0, .Lforward_two
+    ld      t0, 0(a0)
+    ld      t1, 8(a0)
+    ld      t2, 16(a0)
+    ld      t3, 24(a0)
+    sd      t0, 0(a1)
+    sd      t1, 8(a1)
+    sd      t2, 16(a1)
+    sd      t3, 24(a1)
+    addi    a0, a0, 32
+    addi    a1, a1, 32
+.Lforward_two:
+    andi    t0, a2, 2
+    beqz    t0, .Lforward_one
+    ld      t0, 0(a0)
+    ld      t1, 8(a0)
+    sd      t0, 0(a1)
+    sd      t1, 8(a1)
+    addi    a0, a0, 16
+    addi    a1, a1, 16
+.Lforward_one:
+    andi    t0, a2, 1
+    beqz    t0, .Lforward_done
+    ld      t0, 0(a0)
+    sd      t0, 0(a1)
+.Lforward_done:
+    ret
+
+#if defined(__riscv_vector) && __riscv_v_elen >= 64
+    .p2align 4
+.Lforward_rvv:
+    // e64 preserves HeapWord atomicity.
+    vsetvli t0, a2, e64, m2, ta, ma
+    slli    t1, t0, 3
+    vle64.v v0, (a0)
+    vse64.v v0, (a1)
+    add     a0, a0, t1
+    add     a1, a1, t1
+    sub     a2, a2, t0
+    bnez    a2, .Lforward_rvv
+    ret
+#endif
+    .size _Copy_disjoint_words, .-_Copy_disjoint_words
+
+    .p2align 5
+DECLARE_FUNC(_Copy_conjoint_words):
+    slli    t0, a2, 3
+    sub     t1, a1, a0
+    // Unsigned comparison also selects forward copying when dst < src.
+    bgeu    t1, t0, _Copy_disjoint_words
+
+    // Copy backward for overlapping ranges with dst >= src.
+    add     a0, a0, t0
+    add     a1, a1, t0
+    BRANCH_IF_RVV .Lbackward_rvv, t0
+    // Both pointers are just past the remaining ranges.
+    li      a4, 8
+    bltu    a2, a4, .Lbackward_tail
+
+    .p2align 4
+.Lbackward_loop:
+    ld      t0, -8(a0)
+    ld      t1, -16(a0)
+    ld      t2, -24(a0)
+    ld      t3, -32(a0)
+    ld      t4, -40(a0)
+    ld      t5, -48(a0)
+    ld      t6, -56(a0)
+    ld      a3, -64(a0)
+    sd      t0, -8(a1)
+    sd      t1, -16(a1)
+    sd      t2, -24(a1)
+    sd      t3, -32(a1)
+    sd      t4, -40(a1)
+    sd      t5, -48(a1)
+    sd      t6, -56(a1)
+    sd      a3, -64(a1)
+    addi    a0, a0, -64
+    addi    a1, a1, -64
+    addi    a2, a2, -8
+    bgeu    a2, a4, .Lbackward_loop
+
+.Lbackward_tail:
+    andi    t0, a2, 4
+    beqz    t0, .Lbackward_two
+    ld      t0, -8(a0)
+    ld      t1, -16(a0)
+    ld      t2, -24(a0)
+    ld      t3, -32(a0)
+    sd      t0, -8(a1)
+    sd      t1, -16(a1)
+    sd      t2, -24(a1)
+    sd      t3, -32(a1)
+    addi    a0, a0, -32
+    addi    a1, a1, -32
+.Lbackward_two:
+    andi    t0, a2, 2
+    beqz    t0, .Lbackward_one
+    ld      t0, -8(a0)
+    ld      t1, -16(a0)
+    sd      t0, -8(a1)
+    sd      t1, -16(a1)
+    addi    a0, a0, -16
+    addi    a1, a1, -16
+.Lbackward_one:
+    andi    t0, a2, 1
+    beqz    t0, .Lbackward_done
+    ld      t0, -8(a0)
+    sd      t0, -8(a1)
+.Lbackward_done:
+    ret
+
+#if defined(__riscv_vector) && __riscv_v_elen >= 64
+    .p2align 4
+.Lbackward_rvv:
+    vsetvli t0, a2, e64, m2, ta, ma
+    slli    t1, t0, 3
+    sub     a0, a0, t1
+    sub     a1, a1, t1
+    vle64.v v0, (a0)
+    vse64.v v0, (a1)
+    sub     a2, a2, t0
+    bnez    a2, .Lbackward_rvv
+    ret
+#endif
+    .size _Copy_conjoint_words, .-_Copy_conjoint_words
+
+    .section .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits
